content.text:
**Resubmitted — deviation on § 21.1 (LOL-CAP), fallback target.**

Validated proposal (single replace, `ok:true`, minimality clean):

> 21.1 **Except for Excluded Claims, each** Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the ~~one month~~ **twelve (12) months** preceding the event~~, without exception~~.

Rebuilt elementCoverage — all six fallback elements mapped to operation 1 using the exact checklist strings:

| Element | Status |
|---|---|
| The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties. | addressed_by_operation [1] |
| The cap is based on 12 months of fees. | addressed_by_operation [1] |
| Indemnification obligations are uncapped. | addressed_by_operation [1] |
| Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped. | addressed_by_operation [1] |
| Gross negligence is uncapped. | addressed_by_operation [1] |
| Wilful misconduct is uncapped. | addressed_by_operation [1] |

The three uncapped-carve-out elements plus mutuality operate through the retained "each Party's" wording and the new "Except for Excluded Claims" lead-in, which pulls in the § 21.3 definition (indemnification, confidentiality/data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement). Preferred shortfalls — "actually paid" without the USD 1,000,000 floor, and the payment carve-out limited to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" — are disclaimed in the rationale rather than redlined.
